headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for **Warmup Wi-Fi underfloor-heating thermostats** — 4iE, 6iE, 7iE Smart Matter, Element Wi-Fi, Terra Wi-Fi, and rebadged OEM units. Maintained fork of `homebridge-warmup4ie`.
footerDisplay: Need help? See the [README](https://github.com/nookied/homebridge-warmup-v2#readme) or [open an issue](https://github.com/nookied/homebridge-warmup-v2/issues).

name.title: Name
name.description: The name shown in Homebridge logs.

refresh.title: Polling interval (seconds)
refresh.description: How often to fetch room status from the Warmup cloud. Lower values = more responsive, more API load. Warmup may throttle accounts that poll faster than 30s.

duration.title: Override duration (minutes)
duration.description: How long a manual temperature change stays active before the schedule resumes. Maximum 1440 (24 h).

disableChildLock.title: Hide child-lock control
disableChildLock.description: Hides the per-thermostat 'Lock' tile in HomeKit. Useful when the device model doesn't honour the lock command (e.g. Warmup Element Wi-Fi). Cached lock services are removed on next launch.

disableVacationSwitch.title: Hide Vacation Mode switch
disableVacationSwitch.description: Hides the location-wide Vacation Mode HomeKit switch. Cached accessory is removed on next launch.

disableFrostSwitch.title: Hide Frost Protection switch
disableFrostSwitch.description: Hides the location-wide Frost Protection HomeKit switch. Cached accessory is removed on next launch.

disableHistory.title: Disable Eve history graphs
disableHistory.description: Turns off the per-thermostat temperature/heating-state history used by Eve.app. Worth enabling if you don't use Eve: the history library hard-depends on the Google APIs client and loads it on every start even though this plugin only stores history on disk — roughly 105 MB of memory and half a second of startup, per Homebridge process. No HomeKit characteristic changes either way; only Eve's graphs are affected. Existing history files on disk are left alone.

disableAirSensor.title: Hide standalone air-temp sensor
disableAirSensor.description: Hides the standalone 'Air' temperature-sensor tile. The air reading is still surfaced via the Thermostat's CurrentTemperature characteristic, so for users in air-sensor mode this just removes a redundant tile. Leave disabled if your device runs in floor-sensor mode (Thermostat then reports floor temp and the air tile is the only way to see air temp). Cached air-sensor services are removed on next launch.
